senses.gloss:
Hvaras in three passages of the Rigveda^1 denotes, according
to Roth,^2 a part of the Soma sieve, perhaps the part through
which the Soma juice flowed. But Geldner^3 thinks that in all
these cases the sense is merely ‘hindrance.’
1) ix. 3, 2; 63, 4; 106, 13.
2) St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v. 1;
Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 278, n.;
Hillebrandt, Vedische Mythologie, 1,
203.
3) Vedische Studien, 2, 20
